chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Sinan, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “What is the muhsan, may Allah have mercy on you?” He said, “One who has a private part available to him, to which he goes in the morning and returns in the evening.”

key_terms.الْمُحْصَنُ: a legally protected person; here, one meeting the legal condition of ihsan in zina rulings
key_terms.رَحِمَكَ: may He have mercy on you
key_terms.فَرْجٌ: private part; here, a lawful sexual partner being available
key_terms.يَرُوحُ: he returns in the evening; indicating ongoing accessibility
key_terms.يَغْدُو: he goes in the morning; indicating regular access

ai.seo_question: What does muhsan mean in the legal rulings of zina according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the legal meaning of muhsan in the context of the rulings of zina. It indicates that ihsan is established by having regular lawful sexual access, which is relevant to the application of legal penalties.
